en: An illustrated vintage postcard showing an oriental street scene with a large domed mosque and a tall, ornate minaret. The foreground features people in traditional Middle Eastern clothing walking and trading near stone steps and old buildings. The sky is softly colored, and there is handwritten script and a postal cancellation on the lower part of the card. The printed title at the top left reads "Kaït Bey," and at the bottom appears the place name "Le Caire" along with a handwritten date "17-8-902."
